measured.caption: Measured 2026-11-23 on nanocodec development build f9483e0e, PGO (crate version 0.6.0) for 0.6.0's release commit 207745d7 plus only the decode --bench CLI path of 1da4349e2 and 3ca7f3061 (crates/nc-cli decode.rs, help.rs); no decoder code differs; PGO the release way (tools/dev/pgo_build.sh, 0.6.0's four public derf training clips, 20 frames); decoded frames identical to the shipped 0.6.0 binary. AWS c8a.large (AMD EPYC 9R45, Zen 5), one thread pinned to one physical core (CPU 1), one session, ours and the references one after another; in process on both sides (packets in memory, decode loop only, frames discarded; no start-up, probing, demuxing or output): 5 interleaved rounds x 3 passes, median of 15 (tools/dev/decoder_speed.py). Jetson Orin Nano, one Cortex-A78AE core (core 3, clock fixed at 1.728 GHz: scaling min = max), under the board's exclusive timing lock (jetson-timed.sh, 1-minute load settled under 1.5), ours and the references one after another; in process on both sides: 5 interleaved rounds x 3 passes, median of 15 (tools/dev/decoder_speed.py). References: FFmpeg n8.0.1 (libavcodec, static, gcc 15.2 -O3, x86 assembly on) through tools/anchors/libavcodec_bench.c; AV1: dav1d 1.5.4 through libavcodec's libdav1d wrapper; VP9: also libvpx v1.16.0 (vpx_bench.c); VVC: VVdeC d261469 (vvdec_bench.c); AV2: AVM v1.0.0 (avm_bench.c) and dav2d 237229e with its assembly (dav2d_bench.c); each in process with one thread.
